strings.battle_abandon_warning: 确定放弃战斗？放弃后会立即结算，身上装备和背包中非安全格物品都会丢失，仅能带出安全格物品。
Abandon the battle now? The run will be settled immediately. Worn equipment and non-safe backpack items will be lost; only safe-slot items can be brought out.
